key_points: The only Macy's-specific item is the notice that its earnings webcast will be public on Dec. 2, which sets the Q3 FY2026 earnings and guidance date (Macy's historically reports Q3 on/around Dec. 2, after the Nov. 30 quarter end).
No results, guidance, store-closure, or restructuring news in this set. Most other headlines are micro-cap stock sales, warrant terms, buybacks, and 13F activity with no bearing on Macy's.
Macy's revenue and credit card business remain under pressure, and the December report will matter more for buyback and cost-cut details than for headline sales.
Positioning ahead of the Dec. 2 report matters more than this headline; options and watch on gross margin and credit card fees.
